measurement_protocol.cpu_memory: Fresh-worker process RSS high-water through CPU phase, including Python/libraries/model loading. No isolated CPU tensor allocator peak is claimed.
measurement_protocol.cpu_timing: perf_counter_ns wall latency of each full-forecast call
measurement_protocol.cuda_memory: PyTorch peak allocated/reserved bytes after warmup; model and inputs resident; also allocated peak minus resident allocation. Excludes CUDA context and non-PyTorch allocations.
measurement_protocol.cuda_timing: perf_counter_ns wall latency; device synchronize immediately before and after every timed full-forecast call
measurement_protocol.data_access: Only existing exported training-input fixture NPZs; no original datasets, cache, validation or reserved payloads.
measurement_protocol.device_phase_order: CPU before CUDA within each fresh per-case process
measurement_protocol.missing_device_policy: Report unsupported; never invent CUDA rows or mark the combined protocol passed.
measurement_protocol.persistence: One row per task, zero parameters, commands ignored, raw observed feature repeated to materialized [1,59,6144] output using expand(...).clone().
measurement_protocol.publication: Local resource report only; no paper, site or scientific metric updates.
measurement_protocol.scope: Matched inference only; no feature encoder, data loading, host-device transfer, model loading, control loop or accuracy measurement is timed.
